/*SQL-ID :isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.CrisisCounselingPeopleStatsMapper.selectcrisisCounselingPeopleStats : 위기상담 유형별 통계*/ SELECT KBN AS GUBUN , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '01' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W01 /* 임신 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '02' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W02 /* 자살·자해 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '03' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W03 /* 가출 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '04' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W04 /* 가정폭력 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '05' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W05 /* 학교폭력 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '06' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W06 /* 사이버 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '07' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W07 /* 성희롱 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '08' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W08 /* 성폭력 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '09' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W09 /* 폭력기타 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '10' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W10 /* 일반 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '99' OR CRISIS IS NULL THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W99 /* 기타 */ , SUM(CNT) AS SSUM FROM ( SELECT '1' NO1, MAX(CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD) NO2, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM KBN, CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD CRISIS, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT * FROM AYA120 A, AYB200 B, SAC100 C WHERE 1=1
AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.CHRO_NO AND B.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND A.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND A.DEL_YN ='N'
) GROUP BY CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM
UNION ALL
SELECT '2' NO1, MAX(B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD) NO2, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM KBN, A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD CRISIS, COUNT(*) CNT FROM AYA120 A, AYE100 B, SAC100 C WHERE 1=1
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE
GROUP BY A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ) GROUP BY NO1, NO2 ,KBN ORDER BY NO1, NO2 ,KBN

/*SQL-ID :isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.CrisisCounselingPeopleStatsMapper.selectcrisisCounselingPeopleStats2 : 위기상담 상담자별 통계*/ SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(MAX(NM)) AS GUBUN , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '01' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W01 /* 임신 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '02' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W02 /* 자살·자해 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '03' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W03 /* 가출 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '04' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W04 /* 가정폭력 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '05' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W05 /* 학교폭력 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '06' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W06 /* 사이버 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '07' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W07 /* 성희롱 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '08' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W08 /* 성폭력 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '09' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W09 /* 폭력기타 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '10' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W10 /* 일반 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN CRISIS = '99' OR CRISIS IS NULL THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS W99 /* 기타 */ , SUM(CNT) AS SSUM FROM ( -- 채팅 SELECT A.FRST_RGTR_ID ID,MAX(E.FLNM_ENCPT) NM, A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD CRISIS, COUNT(*) CNT FROM AYA120 A, AYB200 B, SAA200 D, SCA100 E WHERE 1=1
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.CHRO_NO AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.USER_ID = A.FRST_RGTR_ID AND D.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO
GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID, A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD UNION ALL -- 게시판 SELECT A.FRST_RGTR_ID ID,MAX(E.FLNM_ENCPT) NM, A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD CRISIS, COUNT(*) CNT FROM AYA120 A, AYE100 B, SAA200 D, SCA100 E WHERE 1=1
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.USER_ID = A.FRST_RGTR_ID AND D.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO
GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID, A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD ) GROUP BY ID ORDER BY ID
